key_findings: Post-treatment with the Class IIa HDAC4/5 inhibitor LMK235 durably reversed chronic trigeminal neuropathic pain behaviors and prevented anxiety-like behavior in mice.
LMK235 prevented injury-induced Hdac5 and P2rx4 upregulation in trigeminal ganglia at 10 weeks.
